messages:
mia: Quick question for the after-hours crowd: one album to soundtrack a three-course dinner party where each course is a different decade. Go.

devon: Starter (60s): "Revolver" - Beatles. Feels fizzy and curious, good for small bites.

hara: Main (90s): "OK Computer" - Radiohead. Brooding, plates get heavier, conversation deepens.

ben: Dessert (10s/20s): "Channel Orange" - Frank Ocean. Warm, slightly awkward, very memorable.

mia: Love the decades approach. Other rules: no instrumental-only albums and no single-artist mixtapes. Keep it cohesive.

devon: Also adding: pass the cheese during Side B of Revolver, it's mandatory.

hara: If anyone wants to actually build this I can sequence transitions so the mood bends slowly between decades.

snack-bot: Free snack inventory: 12 granola bars, 3 bags of pretzels, 1 apple :apple: (automated)

ben: @hara assemble pls. I will supply dessert  miraculously find whipped cream.

mia: This could become a recurring thing: "Decades Dinner Club". Vote if you want an invite reaction.

devon: :thumbsup: Count me in.

hara: :thumbsup: Im in, will make a tiny playlist and DM it.

ben: :thumbsup: bringing whipped cream (promise).
